customers_linked.meaning: contacts with an Amazon reviewer, i.e. with purchases; the arena's population

customers_prospects.meaning: contacts without a reviewer: no purchases, out of leave-one-out by construction

catalogue_products.meaning: products in the shop catalogue = the ranking universe

catalogue_czech_titles.meaning: products with a Czech title (the Czech branch reads it)

interactions.meaning: purchases in the histories (hidden items excluded)

density_percent.meaning: share of the customer x product matrix that is filled

products_bought.meaning: products bought by at least one customer in the histories

products_single_buyer.meaning: of those, bought by exactly one customer

median_buyers_per_bought_product.meaning: median number of customers per bought product

hidden_bought_by_0_others.meaning: hidden items nobody else bought: unreachable for any behavioural method

hidden_bought_by_1_other.meaning: hidden items bought by one other customer

hidden_bought_by_2_to_4_others.meaning: hidden items bought by two to four other customers

hidden_bought_by_5_plus_others.meaning: hidden items bought by five or more other customers

last_day_ties.meaning: customers with two or more reviews on their final day (tie broken by review id)

history_products_median.meaning: median purchases per customer in the history

history_title_words_median.meaning: median words if every bought title is written out (a prompt's history block)

review_words_per_customer_median.meaning: median words of English review text per customer

review_words_per_customer_max.meaning: most review text a single customer wrote

czech_history_texts_empty.meaning: history reviews with no Czech text in the Czech branch (dropped by the May translation run)

random_floor_full_top10.meaning: hit rate of guessing under the full protocol at top 10

random_floor_sampled_top10.meaning: hit rate of guessing under the sampled protocol (100 negatives) at top 10

population_users.meaning: reviewers in the public Amazon Electronics 5-core dump

hidden_bought_by_0_others_in_population.meaning: our hidden items nobody in the population bought

hidden_bought_by_1_to_4_others_in_popula.meaning: our hidden items bought by one to four other reviewers in the population

hidden_bought_by_5_plus_others_in_popula.meaning: our hidden items bought by five or more other reviewers in the population

sanity_users.meaning: random ordinary reviewers (not ours, >= 5 reviews) scored with the population ALS, their chronologically last review hidden, as in the arena

sanity_hits_top10.meaning: of them, hidden interaction in the ALS top 10 over the full population catalogue

sanity_hr10_percent.meaning: the population model's hit rate on ordinary reviewers, the yardstick for the shop's heavy buyers

sanity_seconds.meaning: training + scoring time of the sanity check
